summary: Retest of iteration_16 code-review fixes on /editor: (1) Escape during re-edit now calls cancelText() and restores original text layer, (2) HTML text-layer overlay now has fontWeight:700 to match baked bold pixel output. Both fixes verified. Regressions on cancel-button restore, destructive-op bakes, re-edit style change also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is 1236 lines — consider splitting into hooks (useTextTool, useDraft, useCanvasHistory) and subcomponents (TextOverlay, Toolbar, RightPanel) for maintainability.
In cancelText(), restoring original by appending to end of textObjects can subtly change z-order if the array is used to represent stack order. Consider restoring at original index.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_17 confirmed both code-review fixes: Escape during re-edit restores original layer (verified via [data-testid=text-layer-*] count == 1 after Escape on pre-filled overlay). fontWeight computed style is '700' for text-layer elements. Cancel button also restores original. Rotate/destructive-op bakes text layers correctly (layer count goes to 0 after rotate).
rca of the issue: N/A — fixes verified working. Root cause of prior bug was window keydown Escape handler calling setActiveText(null) directly, skipping the restore-original branch in cancelText(). Fix routes Escape through cancelText() unconditionally.
